# Prime

Prime is a clean, minimal theme that adds subtle color tweaks without changing layout or fonts. Several dark and light code-block syntax themes are available, alongside emoji callout icons and gradient frames, all adjustable through Style Settings.

![Prime screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rivea0/obsidian-prime/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Prime"
    author: "rivea0"
    repo:   "rivea0/obsidian-prime"
    slug:   "prime"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/prime"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/rivea0/obsidian-prime"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/rivea0/obsidian-prime/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a clean, minimal theme that adds subtle color tweaks without changing layout or fonts. Choose from multiple dark and light code-block syntax themes, use emoji callout icons, and add gradient frames, all adjustable via Style Settings."
}
```
